candidates.description: This feature detects punctuation marks, particularly quotation marks and opening parentheses, often found at the beginning of words or clauses.
This vector represents common Italian grammatical words, function words, and adverbial markers.
This vector represents Roman numerals across various casing and formatting styles.
This vector activates strongly on tokens starting with the letter J.
This feature vector represents names, terms, and cultural markers associated with Middle Eastern, South Asian, and Islamic heritage, as well as the linguistic sequence "sh".
This vector activates for words and substrings containing the phonetic sequence "asil" or closely related morphological variants.
This vector activates for word fragments and terms containing the letters "occ" or "acc".
This feature vector activates on subwords and root tokens containing the character sequence "val" or "Val".
This vector represents tokens starting with the letter 'h' in various cases and morphological contexts.
